title: gaultheria pseudorufescens
intro: Gaultheria pseudorufescens, commonly known as Mountain Tea, is a plant species native to the mountainous regions of China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). The therapeutic actions of Gaultheria pseudorufescens include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and organic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
